answer: Each identity must lock a bond before it can act, so spinning up clones costs real capital rather than nothing. The network watches for telltale sameness—a repeated fable, the same timing pulse, a raven call that echoes from a dozen wallets. When it detects cloned behavior, it slashes the bond, seizing and burning the deposit. Honest agents recover their stake; sybils lose the money that made them cheap to fake.
